senses.gloss: śmaśānika = śmā˚, q.v.: AsP 〔387.7〕; Laṅk 〔248.8〕; 〔254.10〕 (all prose).
śmāśānika, m. (also śma˚, q.v.; = Pali sosānika), [] one who frequents cemeteries, one of the 12 dhūtaguṇa, q.v.: Mvy 〔1137〕; Dharmas 〔63〕; Śikṣ 〔135.1〕.
-smaraṇika, adj. (to smaraṇa plus -ika), charged with reminding (of …): āpatti-˚kena bhikṣuṇā MSV 〔iv.124.15〕.
